## Workload

During the review period, grader Hannah Lowe completed 489 reads over 256 hours. This represents a rate of 1.9 reads per hour. The workload record provides the basis for the review of activity and supports a clear comparison between the total number of reads completed and the time recorded.

## Quality

A sample of 33 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The agreement result was 48.5 per cent. This result was considered alongside the recorded workload to provide an overall view of performance.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. The grader and reviewer agreed to retain the current session pattern.
